component.name: TubeFin
component.summary: Watch YouTube and your Jellyfin library

description.p: TubeFin is a focused, native GNOME client that brings YouTube search and a personal Jellyfin media library into one adaptive libadwaita interface.
Search YouTube without an API key, connect to a Jellyfin server, browse libraries, and play compatible media with libmpv.

Speeds up and hardens YouTube playback with authenticated mpv resolution, first-success stream validation, bounded fast-resolver fallbacks, and intent-driven prebuffering across grids, home shelves, account feeds, and detail pages.

Recovers keyboard shortcuts that silently stopped working after a laptop was folded into tablet mode and back, by re-establishing window focus when it regains keyboard focus. Adds a Refresh video button that clears the cached stream and reloads, so a stale expired cache no longer leaves a video stuck on a loading failure.
Fixes touch playback controls so a single tap toggles the seek bar again instead of only showing it while held; the reveal now waits for a real swipe rather than firing on every touch.

Improves the play queue with an inline sidebar, drag-and-drop reordering onto rows or empty space, and click-to-play from anywhere in a playlist; adds channel and search result filters for videos, playlists, and releases that no longer bleed results between tabs when switched quickly; and adds queue and single-video looping with MPRIS controls.

Adds a Subscriptions tab with a channel-avatar filter rail, alphabetical scroll skipper, cached per-channel and aggregate feeds, a refresh button, and infinite scrolling; filters out non-playable YouTube Mix playlists; and backs channel avatars with one persistent shared cache so each resolves once and survives restarts.

Races mpv-direct playback, a persistent validated resolver, and the authenticated reliable resolver for faster cold YouTube starts; automatically hands failed routes to a surviving candidate; and expands diagnostics with per-route timings, validation failures, and the winning path.

Halves uncached YouTube startup time by reusing authenticated session cookies, adds reliable resolver fallback and detailed playback diagnostics, and caches details plus the opening video segment after playback.

Adds authenticated YouTube comment posting, replies, likes, and deletion; chapter-aware seeking and shortcuts; resizable full-height comments and live-chat panels with fullscreen access; channel sharing; and touch-friendly scrolling.

Adds SyncTube room live chat with history, permissions, real-time messages, fullscreen access, and a keyboard shortcut; gives the video a scrollable 16:9 safe area with sticky playback controls; and streamlines player actions.

Fixes timestamp-based queue auto-advance, preserves expanded or mini-player state across skips, queues an entire show when an episode starts, warms upcoming videos for smoother transitions, closes playback options after picker choices, centers channel avatars, adds release dates and descriptions beneath videos, normalizes the details download button, and improves graphics compatibility for packaged builds.

Fixes Seerr discovery, authentication, thumbnails, and Jellyfin-session reuse; adopts native Adwaita season and settings rows; adds drag-and-drop Home ordering and working mini-player transport controls; and improves renderer compatibility.

Adds Seerr requests, expandable Jellyfin series and episode views, metadata-preserving Jellyfin downloads, reorderable and collapsible Home shelves, pull-to-refresh, responsive details, and playback-control polish.
First stable release with YouTube and Jellyfin playback, offline downloads, account sync, watch rooms, SponsorBlock, and MPRIS controls.
